products.title: Kukirin E-Bike Repair Tool Kit
products.body_html:
Description

16-In-1 Multi-function Tool
The 16-in-1 multi-function tool includes 6 hex wrenches, 3 solid wrenches, 3 socket wrenches, a socket extension bar, a spoke wrench, a Phillips screwdriver, and a slotted screwdriver.
Reliable Patches
With 6 pieces of self-adhesive patches, you easily repair a tire for an emergency, which is more convenient and better for the environment than replacing your tube.  
Multiple Functions 
This bike tool kit is designed for multiple functions. The tire levers can be used for installing or replacing bike tires and the patches are for repairing tires. The 16-in-1 tool is helpful for installing and replacing bike accessories.
Compact & Portable Design
The compact tool bag can hold all the tools. Designed with a strap on the back, it can easily slide through a bike tube and carry without any effort.
Ideal Gifts
Crafted with high-grade materials, this sturdy and durable tool kit is an ideal addition to any cyclist's toolbox - whether they’re casual riders or a biking enthusiast.

Package Contents

products.title: Cordless Air Pump
products.body_html:
Description

Powerful and Rechargeable Air Pump
Boasting an impressive 60W output and 22-cylinder design, the air pump delivers a maximum pressure of 150PSI and a maximum airflow of 20L/min, enabling fast and effortless tire pumping. With a 6000mAh battery capacity, the portable air pump can be used to charge your phone and other devices.
Precise Inflation
With a smart display, you can effortlessly set and monitor the exact pressure for your vehicle, ensuring optimal performance and safety on the road. Thanks to the auto-stop design, the air pump stops pumping as soon as it reaches the pre-set value, providing unparalleled accuracy and reliability in tire pumping.
Multifunctional Air Pump
The versatile air pump is designed with 4 modes and 4 different nozzles tailored for various vehicles, including cars, bikes, electric bikes, and balls. With just the touch of a button, effortlessly switch between modes to achieve the perfect inflation for your specific needs. Thanks to the compact design, you can easily carry it with you on trips, bike rides and other outdoor sports.
Durable Extension Tube
Reinforced with an aluminium foil coating and a protective layer, the rubber extension tube is further fortified with a high-strength nylon covering for triple protection, featuring impressive resistance to extreme temperatures, wear and explosions to ensure prolonged use.
Flashlight
The cordless air pump is equipped with an LED flashlight for emergency use. It has 3 light modes including steady white, slow flashing red and fast flashing red to ensure maximum visibility and safety in even the darkest conditions.
Ideal Gifts
Our intelligent, portable air pump is an ideal solution for an emergency, saving you money with precisely inflated tires. It makes the perfect present for your loved ones, making their cycling or driving journeys even more convenient and enjoyable.

Specification

General Type: Portable Air Pump
Color: Black
Basic Specs Materials: ABS + Metal
Cylinder: 22-Cylinder
Air Flow Capacity: 20L/min
Max Pressure: 150PSI
Battery: 6000mAh (2000mAh*3)
Units of Pressure: PSI, KPA, BAR
Suitable for: Cars, Motorcycles, Bicycles, Electric Bikes, Balls, etc.
Weight & Size Net Weight: 585 g
Gross Weight: 875 g
Product Size(L x W x H): 172x70x55 mm
Package Size(L x W x H): 220x150x77 mm
Package Contents 1 x Air Pump
1 x USB Charging Cable
1 x Cigarette Lighter Cable
4 x Air Nozzles
1 x Extension Tube
1 x Portable Bag
